results.questionText: Explain what this repository does.
results.answerText:
This repository, named "klona", provides a JavaScript utility for deep cloning objects, arrays, dates, regular expressions, and other data types [readme.md:71-110]. The library offers different versions with varying levels of support for different data types, including `klona`, `klona/lite`, `klona/full`, and `klona/json` [readme.md:141-180]. 

The `klona` function takes an input object and returns a deep copy of it [readme.md:106-145]. The library is designed to be small and fast, with a size range of 240B to 501B [package.json:1-40]. 

The repository includes benchmarks to compare the performance of `klona` with other libraries, such as `lodash` and `clone` [readme.md:141-180], [bench/package.json:1-14]. It also features test suites to ensure the library works correctly with various data types, including classes [test/suites/class.js:100-114] and maps [test/suites/map.js:1-40]. 

Overall, the "klona" repository provides a lightweight and efficient solution for deep cloning objects in JavaScript.
